question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '​**Whitan**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Whitan**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Whiten**'.
 
• It means 'make or become white.' 
 
 
• *​Example: Snow **whitened** the mountain tops.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Whitan.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the other words:
 
 
• **Enlighten**: to give somebody information so that he/she understands something better. (अपेक्षित जानकारी देते हुए किसी बात की समझ को बढ़ाना)
 
• **Hasten**: to be quick to do or say something. [कोई काम या बात जल्‍दी (लगभग तुरंत) करना या कहना]
 
• **Brighten**: to become brighter or happier; to make something brighter. (चमकना या चमकाना; प्रसन्‍न हो जाना या करना)
